name: Kuranari Takeshi
source:
A university student that has come to LeMU with friends for a day of leisure. He's separated from his friends...and entangled in a horrifying string of events. His personality is usually outgoing, optimistic and sometimes emotional.

[From [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/931349-ever-17-out-of-infinity/faqs/43865]Walkthrough by Denethor0[/url]]

[spoiler]This character is the "Takeshi" of the 2017 LeMU incident. He is the father of both [url=/c25]Hokuto[/url] and [url=/c31]Matsunaga Sara[/url], from his relationship with [url=/c30]Komachi Tsugumi[/url].[/spoiler]
